purpose: Content region inside a tabs composite that becomes visible when its sibling tab with the matching value is active.
useWhen: Hosting the body content associated with a specific tab inside a tabs ancestor.
Letting the tabs context drive aria-labelledby and visibility automatically from the shared value.

avoidWhen.reason: Used outside a tabs ancestor — the component throws at construction.
Rendering the tab trigger itself — use tab inside a tab-list.
